```python
import smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

def send_denial_email(sender_email, sender_password, recipient_email, recipient_name):
    subject = "Clarification Regarding My Identity"
    body = f"""Dear {recipient_name},

I hope this message finds you well. In response to your inquiry, I would like to **clearly deny** any association with the *League of Legends* champion "Faker."

If there was any confusion arising from a username or profile, I apologize for the misunderstanding. My primary account is [Your_Username], and you can verify this by checking [OP.GG_Link].

Best regards,

    msg['Subject'] = subject
    msg['From'] = sender_email
    msg['To'] = recipient_email

        server.login(sender_email, sender_password)

```
